parent_protocol.fit: baseline training only: median over auto-spectral cells of mean(numerator at M=1) / repeat-record variance
parent_protocol.primary_family: auto: exact auto-spectral variance form; real/imaginary cross approximations are validated separately
parent_protocol.interpretation: calibrate the implemented estimated-auto-spectrum numerator; fitted M is not a literal Welch-segment count
parent_protocol.diagnostics: separate auto, real-cross, imaginary-cross and all-entry required M; no frequency-dependent M fitted
parent_protocol.validation: fresh held-out baseline, long-period and weak-wave records; fixed training M; no inverse or wave-truth scoring
parent_protocol.adoption: do not apply an auto-calibrated value globally if the cross-spectral variance approximation is incompatible
parent_protocol.scope: preserve existing forward/inverse assumptions; no independent-model overhaul in this study

decision: fixed baseline-auto training M; no test fitting, inverse, or wave-truth inputs
primary: median absolute log variance-ratio error across full-band cross entries; report signed bias and per-family results too
tolerance: +/-10 percent for pooled median variance ratios; exploratory pointwise intervals are not simultaneous
candidate: auto = a^2/M; cross Re/Im = [(M-1)/(2*(M-2))*(a*b-|z|^2) + Re(z)^2 or Im(z)^2]/M
interpretation: M remains the fitted implemented auto denominator; complex-Wishart effective averages L=M-1; no extra fitted parameter
